item.title: Version 1.5.6
item.changes: - Animated GIFs: a GIF imports as one layer with its frames in a strip under the canvas, to play, paint on, duplicate, delete and retime; Export As saves animated GIFs. - Search the Layers panel by name, or show only one kind of layer or the selected ones. - The tool bar moves into two columns when the window is too short for one. - Canvas Size keeps the zoom, so added or trimmed canvas shows as such.
